05 · THE TECHNOLOGY

HAL Intelligence

HAL evaluates signals, market conditions and strategy decisions inside supported trading bots. It is independent of BeeBot and The HIVE.

HAL · INTELLIGENCE FEATURE

Smarter decisions.

HAL helps evaluate signals, market conditions and strategy decisions. Manual, Hybrid and Sentience capabilities vary by bot and edition.

VIEW SLIDESHOWS ↗
HAL THINK BOX · PATTERN RULES + PLAIN ENGLISH BETA

Give your bot custom thinking.

Go beyond preset strategies. Build precise pattern-entry rules in the Custom Pattern Rule editor, or try describing an idea in everyday language using the new Plain English (Beta) tab.

  • Pattern Library: explore supported triangles, double tops and bottoms, engulfing candles, hammers and shooting stars.
  • Custom Pattern Rule: configure touches, breakout confirmation, RVOL, time windows and other pattern-specific conditions. Supported saved rules can filter new entries.
  • Plain English (Beta): type a trading instruction, click Preview JSON, then edit the generated JSON draft directly.
  • See your logic: inspect rule settings and, for supported saved pattern rules, review entry-blocking decisions.
Plain English → editable JSON ↗ Adaptive pattern rule editor ↗

EARLY BETA — Plain English currently uses a limited phrase interpreter, not an AI language model. Its JSON output is an editable preview only: it is not saved, validated as a live rule or sent to the trading engine. More language understanding, patterns and rule options are planned. Availability depends on bot and edition.

Advanced Chart — Live Trading & Analysis

LIVE CLICK TRADING from the chart: plan LONG and SHORT entries visually, set bracket-order entry, stop-loss and take-profit levels, and work with live broker-connected pricing.

  • Long / short chart trade plans and bracket order staging

  • Private local drawings and personal chart workspace

Control Panel

Free desktop hub for launching and organizing installed Trading Bots tools. Download package will be linked after upload.

HAL Think Box — Give Your Bot Custom Thinking

Two ways to customize your thinking: use the adaptive Custom Pattern Rule editor to define supported pattern-entry conditions, or experiment with the Plain English (Beta) tab by describing a trade idea in everyday language.

Custom Pattern Rule: select a supported pattern and configure its measurements, including touches, swing confirmation, breakout closes, relative volume and trading-session limits. Where supported by the bot, saved and enabled pattern rules are evaluated before entries and may block trades that fail their conditions.

Plain English (Beta): a limited local phrase interpreter recognizes selected pattern conditions and creates an editable JSON draft. Press Preview JSON to generate it, then edit the JSON yourself. This tab does not use an AI language model; it does not save, validate or submit the draft to the trading engine.

Explore the two screenshots in the HAL Think Box feature card. More patterns, language capabilities and customization are planned as they are built and tested. Feature availability varies by bot and edition. Pattern recognition and automation cannot guarantee trading results.

HAL Intelligence

HAL is the configurable intelligence layer used by higher-level trading bots for signal evaluation and market-context checks. Modes and actual capabilities differ by bot, Free Beta and Premium release.

BeeBot + The Hive

Planned opt-in network for sharing strategy setups, selected symbol metrics and aggregate results. BeeBot is intended as the sole direct Hive connector. Other bots retain local CSV history, with optional historical imports through BeeBot. Not yet live.
